assumptions: Frame: x to the right of the heading, z forward along it, metres; yaw is relative to the heading, compass sense. Piece sizes and which model axis is long are not known offline: walls and containers keep their centres at least 5 m off the lane axis so a quarter-turn error cannot block the lane. Nothing here is observed in DayZ. All tier_hint and threat_hint fields are descriptive placement guidance only, not CE tier overrides or AI spawners. Footprint reserves in classes.json are unmeasured; clear rectangles test piece centres only, not physical bounds. New scenes keep structural centres at least 8 m from the access axis. Furniture, radios, fuel, lamps and crates are inert static dressing; model pivots and emitted light are unverified. No custom loot, bodies, AI or working weapons are spawned.

abandoned-checkpoint.layout_notes: Road runs along z, with a seven metre central passage. Sheds face inward and the nest covers the +z arrival; wrecks remain on the shoulders.
abandoned-checkpoint.purpose: A road inspection team left its paperwork beside a disabled patrol vehicle; staggered barriers and empty supply crates mark an orderly checkpoint that stopped receiving orders.

ammo-dump.layout_notes: Approach +z. Containers have separated loading aprons; central truck aisle remains open. Crates are static dressing and never create ammunition directly.
ammo-dump.purpose: A dispersed ammunition transfer point was abandoned mid-unload; open containers and a cargo truck flank pallet stacks behind blast screens.

bandit-roadblock.layout_notes: Road axis z has a seven metre passage. Shoulders carry angled barriers, a nest overlooking +z and a screened sleeping area; vehicles never close the lane.
bandit-roadblock.purpose: A stolen cargo vehicle and improvised inspection desk turned a rural road into an extortion point; the sleeping shelter sits behind the ambush position.

checkpoint.layout_notes: Preserved original layout with central access lane; native model-axis, door and collision survey pending. Additional guard shelter is outside the original perimeter where present. One wire segment is removed to leave an additional exit and keep the original piece budget.
checkpoint.purpose: A two-lane-wide road checkpoint: hedgehogs and concrete blocks funnel traffic into a 7 m lane, a guard shed with a sandbag line and a table sit on one side, razor wire and a flag behind.

comms-post.layout_notes: Preserved original layout with central access lane; native model-axis, door and collision survey pending. Additional guard shelter is outside the original perimeter where present. One wire segment is removed to leave an additional exit and keep the original piece budget.
comms-post.purpose: A radio post: three antenna masts at the back, an ops shed with a sandbag screen on one side, HBarrier wall on the other, a table and chairs, a parked wreck and razor wire across the front.

crashed-convoy.layout_notes: Road axis z remains clear. Wrecks sit on opposite shoulders with varied headings; scattered cases follow the eastern truck rather than a uniform ring.
crashed-convoy.purpose: The lead vehicle veered off the road and the convoy halted under fire; scattered cargo leads from a truck to a hastily established casualty station.

field-hospital.layout_notes: Preserved original layout with central access lane; native model-axis, door and collision survey pending. Additional guard shelter is outside the original perimeter where present.
field-hospital.purpose: A medical camp: a large medical tent as the loot focus, a shower tent beside it, a triage table and chairs under a camo net, supply pallets and crates, razor wire on the flanks and hedgehogs at the entrance.

field-hq.layout_notes: Approach from +z along the central lane; accommodation and command tents form a row. Nest covers arrival; generator sits away from sleeping quarters. The unpowered transit radio is staged beside the external command desk; no unmeasured tabletop dy is assumed.
field-hq.purpose: A command element packed its maps and abandoned the last working radio; the protected signals desk and orderly tent row contrast with a hurried vehicle departure.

fob-compound.layout_notes: Approach +z through an open seven metre gate. Perimeter segments are deliberately broken at the front; cot staging lies beyond tent footprints.
fob-compound.purpose: A forward base had settled into routine: a command tent, two sleeping rows and a fortified watch position surround an empty parade and delivery lane.

forward-outpost.layout_notes: Guard tower at local (-8.1, 0.47, 19.95), yaw 315, outside the northwest entrance corner; its measured Geometry bounds clear every wall and prop and remain west of the central lane. Native doorway, ladder, sightline and terrain checks remain pending.
forward-outpost.purpose: A walled outpost with an HBarrier perimeter, an entrance gap facing the approach, and a guard tower at the northwest entrance corner covering the central lane in the local layout. Sandbag cover lines sit inside the gate, a tent and camo net shelter the work area at the back, and hedgehogs sit outside the gate.

fuel-depot.layout_notes: Approach +z along a vehicle aisle. Fuel vessels are separated from accommodation and the generator; tanks and cans are inert dressing.
fuel-depot.purpose: A refuelling detachment left a tanker in the service bay and spare cans at the pump crew desk; guarded storage sits clear of the fuel tanks.

helicopter-lz.layout_notes: Approach +z along the access lane. Keep the central pad clear: x -12..12, z -15..15. Crash wreck is well west; reflectors and edge lights are inert props pending native observation.
helicopter-lz.purpose: A forward landing zone became a recovery site when the evacuation helicopter crashed beyond its perimeter; ground crew staging survives beside the empty pad.

hunter-camp.layout_notes: Approach +z on a footpath. Caravan, abandoned car and guard hide provide native civilian/military proto points; no animal or loot script is attached.
hunter-camp.purpose: Hunters turned a caravan pull-off into a long stay: a cooking corner, stacked firewood and an observation hide look over the track.

mass-grave-cleanup.layout_notes: Approach +z. Grave and excavator occupy a separate western work zone; clean treatment and wash-down tents flank the open access aisle. No bodies, infected or rewards are scripted.
mass-grave-cleanup.purpose: A burial and decontamination detail abandoned its machinery beside a fresh mass grave; triage, wash-down and bagged protective equipment mark the final work shift.

medevac-station.layout_notes: Approach +z. Central ambulance aisle stays open. Beds and triage desk are external stations, separated from tent doorways; generator is behind the treatment row.
medevac-station.purpose: Casualties were sorted between the triage desk and two treatment tents while an evacuation pickup waited outside; stretchers still line the transfer route.

mg-nest.layout_notes: Preserved original layout with central access lane; native model-axis, door and collision survey pending. Additional guard shelter is outside the original perimeter where present. One wire segment is removed to leave an additional exit and keep the original piece budget.
mg-nest.purpose: A fortified nest with a sandbag arc facing the approach, HBarrier wings, razor wire in front and a crate pair behind; open at the back.

mortar-pit.layout_notes: Approach +z. The empty artillery emplacement is off the lane to the west; no working mortar or fabricated weapon class is spawned. The nest watches the approach.
mortar-pit.purpose: An artillery crew withdrew with the weapons but left its revetment, ammunition handling area and plotting station intact.

motor-pool.layout_notes: Approach +z. Vehicles are parallel in spaced bays to the east; the workshop is west of the clear service lane. Wrecks cannot be driven or produce repaired vehicles.
motor-pool.purpose: A repair and recovery crew cannibalised an APC beside two parked logistics trucks; tools and transit cases remain outside the workshop tent.

overrun-camp.layout_notes: Approach +z. Tent entrances face the central assembly lane; the eastern wire is interrupted intentionally. No debris lies in the lane or tent entrances.
overrun-camp.purpose: A tent row was breached at the eastern perimeter; an abandoned APC, skewed furniture and a trail of discarded medical supplies lead out through the gap.

police-blockade.layout_notes: Road axis z remains passable. Cruisers are shoulder parked, not across the road. Sandbag protection covers the registration desk from the +z approach.
police-blockade.purpose: Police attempted traffic diversion while a military guard team handled detainee screening; two abandoned cruisers and a document desk show where the queue stopped.

quarantine-post.layout_notes: Approach +z. Registration west, examination east, shower at the rear. Wire stays outside tents and the open road lane; bags never block doors.
quarantine-post.purpose: A roadside screening station separated arrivals from the clean treatment row; a discarded protective bag trail marks the containment breach.

radio-relay.layout_notes: Approach +z. Equipment sits behind a transverse HBarrier line with an open centre; accommodation is offset from generator and antenna bases.
radio-relay.purpose: A remote relay kept broadcasting after the convoy stopped coming; three antenna masts and a sheltered operator station dominate the skyline.

refugee-camp.layout_notes: Approach +z. Bus is parked outside the shelter row; communal cooking is west of tents, away from canvas. Medical access and the central foot lane remain open.
refugee-camp.purpose: A bus delivered families to a relief camp that outlived its supplies; folding beds, shared meals and a registration desk remain between two shelter rows.

sniper-overwatch.layout_notes: +z is the watched approach. Nest and guard shelter are staggered; camo screens protect the rear equipment bench without sealing the retreat lane.
sniper-overwatch.purpose: An observation team watched the valley from two offset fighting positions; a radio and spare equipment sit behind the covered withdrawal route.

supply-drop-site.layout_notes: Approach +z. The central recovery lane is clear; a widely scattered line of static cases leads to the eastern truck. No dynamic event or duplicate scripted rewards are created.
supply-drop-site.purpose: A ground team recovered an air-delivered consignment into open containers, then abandoned the sorting line; separated transit crates trace the movement from drop to truck.

supply-dump.layout_notes: Preserved original layout with central access lane; native model-axis, door and collision survey pending. Additional guard shelter is outside the original perimeter where present.
supply-dump.purpose: A fenced supply yard: two military containers and two static containers frame a vehicle lane that ends at a parked wreck, pallets and crates by the entrance, a fuel tank to one side, razor wire and hedgehogs across the entrance.

tent-camp.layout_notes: Preserved original layout with central access lane; native model-axis, door and collision survey pending. Additional guard shelter is outside the original perimeter where present.
tent-camp.purpose: Two military tents either side of a central path, a camo-net table area at the back, a sandbag cover line and razor wire at the front, crates and a fuel tank at the edges.
